definitions.explanation: A thick, slippery liquid secreted by living organisms, or any viscous, gel-like substance.

examples.japanese: カタツムリ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{粘液|ねんえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。

⟦{鼻|はな}→鼻：02164_hana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{粘液|ねんえき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ウイルス→ウイルス：05223_uirusu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{侵入|しんにゅう}→侵入：11440_shinnyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦{役割|やくわり}→役割：03638_yakuwari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Nasal mucus plays a role in preventing viruses from entering.

examples.japanese: ⟦なめくじ→なめくじ：18420_namekuji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}った→通る：01243_tooru⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{光|ひか}る→光る：01163_hikaru⟧{粘液|ねんえき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{跡|あと}→跡：02174_ato⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っていた→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: After the slug passed, a shiny trail of slime remained.

notes:
Composed of {粘|ねん} (sticky, viscous) + ⟦{液|えき}→液：02270_eki⟧ (liquid, fluid). Used in both biological/medical contexts (bodily mucus) and general descriptions of slimy substances produced by organisms like snails and slugs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {粘液|ねんえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分泌|ぶんぴつ}→分泌：25492_bunpitsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — secrete mucus
- {粘液|ねんえき}{質|しつ} — mucous, slimy (quality)
- {粘液|ねんえき}{膜|まく} — mucous membrane
- ⟦{鼻|はな}→鼻：02164_hana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{粘液|ねんえき} — nasal mucus

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{鼻水|はなみず}→鼻水：04430_hanamizu⟧ — runny nose, nasal discharge; the everyday word for nose mucus, while {粘液|ねんえき} is more technical
- ⟦{唾液|だえき}→唾液：15943_daeki⟧ — saliva; another bodily fluid, but watery rather than viscous
- ⟦ねばねば→ねばねば：05258_nebaneba⟧ — sticky, slimy (onomatopoeia); describes the texture of {粘液|ねんえき} in casual speech
